info.title: How the service works
lines: "By VIN" button — search the catalog of your car by VIN (17 chars, e.g. JN8AS05Y37X012345).
"By part number" button — enter the part number (e.g. W339055SA).
"By name" button — enter the part name (e.g. "front brake pads").
Response from the warehouse: original and/or analogs with stock and price.
Our manager contacts you to confirm the order and arrange payment.
Express delivery: 2–4 hours, Mon–Sat 09:00–16:30, fee 4,000 KZT.
Pickup: next day, 14:00–18:00, 68 Respublika Ave, Astana.
In your account you can save several of your cars and switch between them in one tap — every page shows which car the search is for.
